subject: AcmeHealth GDPR: DPA / SCC selection & controller/processor alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Pedro Sanchez <pedro.sanchez@acmehealth.com>, Leah Park <leah.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T15:30:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap: DPA / SCC selection & controller/processor alignment

Hi Pedro / Leah,

Great to speak earlier — thanks for taking the time. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned on GDPR requirements for the Acme Health POC: 

Call highlights
- Acme Health is the Controller for patient data; Redwood will act as Processor for the inference/embedding service.
- Your legal team wants the standard DPA + SCCs included; from the call it sounded like you prefer controller-to-processor SCC language (commonly referred to as Module 2 / controller-to-processor).
- You also asked about SOC 2 and HIPAA/BAA readiness for production.

Attachments / links I shared
- Redwood DPA (draft) — redwood_dpa_draft_20261005.pdf (attached)
- SCC module mapping (what modules map to which roles) — scc_module_map_20261005.xlsx (attached)
- Mutual Action Plan template for contracting timeline — mutual_action_plan_acme_20261005.docx (attached)
- Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cDPARepo

Proposed next steps
1) Please confirm that Acme Health will sign as Controller and request Redwood as Processor (this confirms Module 2 is appropriate).
2) Once confirmed, we'll provide a DPA + SCC bundle (we can share a DocuSign-ready copy).
3) If you need SOC 2 Type II report access or a BAA, we'll share those under NDA — let me know which is needed now vs during legal review.
4) Rishi and I will coordinate contracting cadence; suggested target: initial legal review within 5 business days, signature within 2-3 weeks if no redlines.

If that matches your recollection, I'll kick off the DocuSign flow and loop in our legal ops.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Date: 2026-10-06T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: DPA / SCC selection & controller/processor alignment

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed: Acme Health will be Controller; Redwood will be Processor. We do expect controller-to-processor SCCs (Module 2).
- For the DPA, our legal team typically requests: data retention specifics (we showed 7 years in the call as an example), subprocessors list and notification cadence, and a clause covering Data Subject Request support.
- We will need SOC 2 Type II report access for our security review and a BAA if PHI is involved. For the initial POC there may be limited PHI; we'll confirm with Compliance and loop back.

Can you confirm whether Redwood's standard DPA already contains the Controller/Processor alignment language and Module 2 SCCs, or whether you'll propose an amendment? Also please share the timeline for SOC 2 report access and the BAA (if available).

I'll loop in our internal legal contact (legal@acmehealth.com) and Leah will coordinate timelines.

Thanks,
Pedro Sanchez
Senior PM, Privacy & Compliance
Acme Health

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: DPA / SCC selection & controller/processor alignment

Pedro / Leah,

Thanks for the confirmation. A few concrete follow-ups from our side: 

1) Controller/Processor & SCCs: Confirmed — we will send a DPA that references the controller-to-processor SCCs (Module 2). Our standard DPA already includes a controller/processor section; we will bundle the SCC module in the DocuSign package.

2) SOC 2 & BAA: Redwood maintains a current SOC 2 Type II report. We can provide a copy under NDA; if you'd like access to the auditor report (read-only), let me know and I'll have security ops send a secure link. Regarding HIPAA/BAA: we have a BAA addendum we can attach if PHI will be processed.

3) Specific asks you mentioned (retention, subprocessors, DSR support): our DPA draft covers retention and subprocessors; for subprocessors we provide a frequently-updated list and 30 days' notice before new subprocessors are added (exceptions can be discussed). Data Subject Request tooling / support is described in section 4 of the DPA.

Next steps (I'll action these today):
- Publish DocuSign package with: DPA draft + SCC Module 2 bundle + Mutual Action Plan. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/templates/redwood-dpa-2026
- Share SOC 2 access instructions under NDA (please confirm the right legal contact for the NDA).
- Suggest a short legal-to-legal sync if your counsel wants to go through redlines live.

If that works, I'll push the DocuSign invite and tag Rishi to coordinate timeline / billing questions.

Cheers,
Marissa
